responsibilities: Support the BI strategy for DIS
Generate new ideas for creative and effective methods of presenting management information and implement these into proof-of-concept dashboards
Designing robust and scalable workflows and ETL processes using a variety of tools and technologies
Develop complex data models and front end reports in Power BI
Develop best practices for data management, security and quality control
Ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency throughout the data lifecycle
Lead the full lifecycle of BI projects, from requirements gathering to deployment and maintenance, demonstrating ownership and accountability for results
Ability to read and debug SQL
Proactively identify opportunities for improvement in existing BI processes and systems, proposing and implementing solutions
Guide and mentor junior developers, fostering their growth and development within the team
Build strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders to support the execution of reporting activities and help on resolving any reporting and data issues
Effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, fostering collaboration and understanding
Support projects, reporting applications changes and upgrades.
Share knowledge with team across the DIS to support continuous improvement and development

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency throughout the data lifecycle
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Quality and governance bullets ("Ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency throughout the data lifecycle", best practices for security and quality control) carry the role, and there are no speed phrases.
evidence.domain_risk: delivering timely and quality standard management and operations reporting
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The output is management and operations reporting for a drinks bottler's business units, so errors affect business decisions without stated regulatory or financial-reporting exposure.
evidence.collaboration_width: DIS teams; D&A Teams; Finance; IT; Master Data
evidence.data_team_maturity: enable management of existing end-to-end BI solutions
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The role joins an established function with existing BI solutions and several named data teams (DIS teams, D&A Teams, reporting teams), so the team is mature.
evidence.jd_authorship: Develop complex data models and front end reports in Power BI
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: A few bullets name the concrete work ("Develop complex data models and front end reports in Power BI"), but most are generic lines about strategy, best practices and stakeholder relationships.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: support the Data and insights Services teams as well as the Business Units
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role serves both the internal data teams and the business units' management reporting with equal weight ("support the Data and insights Services teams as well as the Business Units").
evidence.autonomy_level: Lead the full lifecycle of BI projects
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns BI projects end to end ("Lead the full lifecycle of BI projects") while also supporting the BI strategy and reporting changes set by others.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The posting does not mention AI tools or AI-facing data work.
evidence.testing_framing: Develop best practices for data management, security and quality control
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality is an owned responsibility ("Develop best practices for data management, security and quality control"), not a tool in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: help on resolving any reporting and data issues
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Accuracy and resolving reporting issues matter, but they sit behind delivery of reports and dashboards, with no compliance or audit framing.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Proactively identify opportunities for improvement in existing BI processes and systems
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Most infrastructure work is managing and improving existing BI solutions, with proof-of-concept dashboards as the only new-build element.
evidence.language_gate: English – C1 and above/Native...Any other language is an advantage
evidence.loss_aversion: Ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency throughout the data lifecycle — accuracy is a stated responsibility, framed as reporting quality rather than regulatory risk.
ats_keywords: front end reports in Power BI
